questions.title: What can you do if your ball goes into a yellow water area?
questions.question: Your ball lands in a yellow water area, like a pond. If you don’t want to drop your ball behind the water, what else can you do?

choices.text: You have to hit the ball from the water area where it landed.
You can go back to where you last hit your shot, take a one-shot penalty, and play again.
You can drop your ball on the green with no penalty.
You can only keep going if you find your first ball.

questions.explanation: If your ball goes into a yellow water area, you can go back to where you last hit the ball, get a one-shot penalty, and try again from there. If your last shot was from the tee, you can put your ball on a tee again.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place on the course like a pond or stream, marked by yellow or red lines or stakes, where special rules apply.
You add one extra shot to your score for that hole.
The little stand you put your ball on when you start a hole.

questions.teachingTip: Show children the yellow lines or stakes that mark penalty areas on the course. Use a ball and point out where they could go back to play again if their ball lands in the water.
likelyMisconceptions: Thinking you can always go straight to the green without penalty.
Believing you must find your original ball to keep playing.
Not knowing you can go back and hit again with a penalty.

questions.title: Returning to previous spot after water hazard
questions.question: If your shot ends up in a yellow penalty area and you don't want to drop behind the hazard, what other relief option do you have?

choices.text: You must play the ball where it lies in the penalty area.
You can go back to where you last played the shot and play again, taking a one-stroke penalty.
You may drop the ball on the green without penalty.
You can only keep playing if you find your original ball.

questions.explanation: You can go back to the spot of your last shot and play again from there for a one-stroke penalty. If your previous shot was from the tee, you are allowed to tee up as well.
